Standard RDP Security compatibility adapter

The Tomato adapter implements the legacy wire format documented by Microsoft
MS-RDPBCGR, sections 2.2.1.10 and 5.3. It is only instantiated for a negotiated
legacy connection. TLS and CredSSP keep their existing transports.

RC4 is provided by RustCrypto rc4 0.1.0, licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0.
Source: https://github.com/RustCrypto/stream-ciphers/tree/rc4-v0.1.0/rc4
SHA-1 and MD5 are provided by RustCrypto sha1 and md-5, MIT OR Apache-2.0.
RSA parsing/public-key arithmetic uses RustCrypto rsa, MIT OR Apache-2.0.
These are normal locked Cargo dependencies; no external RDP executable is used
by the application.

Independent QA uses the FreeRDP 3.32.2 synthetic sample (Apache-2.0) and JDK JCA
reference calculations. FreeRDP/OpenSSL fixture binaries are workspace-only test
tools, are never installed, and are not included in Tomato release packages.
The sample binds to IPv4 loopback and generates a test image; no user desktop
or saved remote connection is used by this fixture.
